chapter: Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste — Continued
act_title: Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste — Continued

quests.title: Good Stuff, but Terrible Taste — Continued

dialogue.t: Hmm... Paimon can't stand how these objects look... Somehow, it reminds Paimon of those ugly things we saw last time...
<color=#00E1FFFF>Why is there a Hydro Monument buried underground</color>? Paimon doesn't get it...
{NICKNAME}, should we rearrange it? Just like how Salsa taught us!
Phew, this looks so much better. Salsa would be proud of us if she saw this, don't you think so, Traveler?
Robbers! A robbery in broad daylight!
Huh!? Robbers? Where?
I'm talking about you two! Not only did you destroy my masterpiece, you even took the chest...

dialogue.sit: So it really was the work of an Adventurers' Guild member...
Wait, it's the evil green guy!

dialogue.t: What work on earth? I should be asking you guys about what you did!
So, these ugly things are your "masterpieces"?
The audacity! What do you mean "ugly things"? Haven't you heard of installation art?
Looks like Fontaine's art education still has a long way to go... Oh, but you two don't look like you're from Fontaine.
That's because we are not from Fontaine. Paimon's Paimon, and he(she) is {NICKNAME}. We are also members of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogue.sit: We are members of an evil organization... *sob*

dialogue.t: Yeah, but we don't have to wear uniforms. So we're not bad guys in green, yay!
I'm Ubu, an adventurer and installation artist. Seeing how you guys are making zero sense, I'm guessing you're often up to crazy shenanigans... I won't pursue this matter this time.
Huh? Actually...
What? I need to restore the work, so if you want to say thank you, do it quickly.
I have nothing to thank you for, but I sure have a million things I wanna yell at you for!
Salsa!
With me around, you don't have to be scared, Paimon!
Evil green guy, we have destroyed all of the traps laid by you! Stop trying to ruin our beautiful Fontaine with your sinister traps!
Ruin? Wait, "destroyed all"? ...You destroyed all of my artworks!?
Umm, we didn't exactly destroy them... We just rearranged them to suit the surrounding scenery...
You...! You brats and plebeians! How could you hope to understand art! To turn my installation art, my works into something so mediocre and mundane...
But is it really art? Paimon doesn't know much about it, but can you really call something that looks so out of place art?
Of course, the boundaries of art are set by the artist. A work created by an artist is naturally called a work of art.
Who's the artist?
It is I, Ubu, the extraordinary installation artist.
In that case, as the founder of the "Alliance of Artists to Overthrow the Evil Organization and Protect the Future of Fontaine," I declare that I do not recognize it as art.
"Overthrow the E—" ...What?

dialogue.sit: Basically, we have to take you down.

dialogue.t: It refers to the Adventurers' Guild that is ruining the scenery with, umm, installation art...
What a joke, I've never heard of such an alliance. Kid, what gives you the right to say that my work isn't art?
I'm a painter, so you could say I'm an artist. Of course I'm qualified.
Huh? Look, kid, being an artist isn't some child's play. You can't say you're an artist just because you want to become one. You gotta have works that are recognized by people...
So what makes you qualified? Your works, the installation art you speak of... Those evil traps? Do people clap when they see them?
That's because there are too many plebeians who can't comprehend the charm of my works. True art is always the least understood...

dialogue.sit: You should start from making art that people can actually understand.
Simply put, no one understands it at all.

dialogue.t: Yeah, if no one understands, it's either too avant-garde, or simply...
No... It can't be! My works are perfect! There is absolutely nothing wrong with them! You guys just don't understand, people just don't understand...
Darn it, I'm not giving up! This isn't over!
What a stubborn enemy! But I'm not giving up either! The future of Fontaine's art rests on my shoulders!

dialogue.sit: We all have a goal to work towards.

dialogue.t: Is this a good thing? It probably is, right?
Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

dialogue.sit: Did you manage to recruit new members for the alliance?

dialogue.t: I found prospective members who are willing to participate, but I need to carry out a rigorous assessment to make sure they have the right qualifications. After all, Fontaine's future is at stake.

quests.description: The traps set by the evil person in green have yet to be taken down…
